001package com.streamConverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
006import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SendHttpCommand;
007import com.streamConverter.command.impl.xml.XmlNavigateCommand;
008import com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
009import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
010import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.io.InputStream;
013import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
014import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
015import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
016import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
017import org.slf4j.Logger;
018import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
019
020/**
021 * Complex XML processing pipeline demonstrating: HTTPS → XML parsing → DB lookup → API call → XML
022 * transformation → Response
023 *
024 * <p>This example showcases a real-world enterprise integration scenario where: 1. Large XML is
025 * received via HTTPS 2. Specific tag values are extracted as keys 3. Database lookup is performed
026 * using those keys 4. Backend API is called with the retrieved values 5. Returned XML is processed
027 * with reverse transformation 6. Final response is sent back to the original requester
028 */
029public class ComplexXmlProcessingPipeline {
030
031  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ComplexXmlProcessingPipeline.class);
032  private static final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(10);
033
034  /**
035   * アプリケーションのエントリーポイント。複雑なXML処理パイプラインの例を実行します。
036   *
037   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
038   */
039  public static void main(String[] args) {
040    logger.info("🌐 Complex XML Processing Pipeline");
041    logger.info("==================================");
042
043    try {
044      // Example 1: Basic pipeline demonstration
045      demonstrateBasicPipeline();
046
047      // Example 2: Full end-to-end processing
048      demonstrateFullProcessing();
049
050      // Example 3: Error handling and recovery
051      demonstrateErrorHandling();
052
053      // Example 4: Performance optimization
054      demonstratePerformanceOptimization();
055
056    } catch (Exception e) {
057      logger.error("Pipeline demonstration failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
058    } finally {
059      executor.shutdown();
060    }
061  }
062
063  /** Demonstrates basic pipeline structure */
064  private static void demonstrateBasicPipeline() throws IOException {
065    System.out.println("📋 Basic Pipeline Structure");
066    System.out.println("============================");
067
068    // Sample incoming XML with user request
069    String incomingXml =
070        """
071        <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
072        <request>
073          <header>
074            <requestId>REQ001</requestId>
075            <timestamp>2023-07-15T10:30:00Z</timestamp>
076            <source>mobile-app</source>
077          </header>
078          <body>
079            <user>
080              <userId>USR123</userId>
081              <sessionId>SES456</sessionId>
082              <action>getUserProfile</action>
083            </user>
084            <parameters>
085              <param name="includePreferences">true</param>
086              <param name="format">json</param>
087            </parameters>
088          </body>
089        </request>
090        """;
091
092    System.out.println("📨 Incoming XML:");
093    System.out.println(incomingXml);
094
095    // Step 1: Extract user ID for DB lookup
096    System.out.println("\n🔍 Step 1: Extract user ID for DB lookup");
097    IStreamCommand extractUserId =
098        XmlNavigateCommand.create("request/body/user/userId", new PassThroughRule());
099    processStep(incomingXml, extractUserId, "User ID extraction");
100
101    // Step 2: Extract session ID for validation
102    System.out.println("\n🔍 Step 2: Extract session ID for validation");
103    IStreamCommand extractSessionId =
104        XmlNavigateCommand.create("request/body/user/sessionId", new PassThroughRule());
105    processStep(incomingXml, extractSessionId, "Session ID extraction");
106
107    System.out.println("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
108  }
109
110  /** Demonstrates full end-to-end processing */
111  private static void demonstrateFullProcessing() throws IOException {
112    System.out.println("🔄 Full End-to-End Processing");
113    System.out.println("==============================");
114
115    // Large XML document simulation
116    String largeXmlRequest = generateLargeXmlRequest();
117
118    System.out.println("📊 Processing large XML request...");
119    System.out.println("Request size: " + largeXmlRequest.length() + " characters");
120
121    // Create comprehensive processing pipeline
122    IStreamCommand[] fullPipeline = createFullProcessingPipeline();
123
124    long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
125
126    try (InputStream inputStream =
127            new ByteArrayInputStream(largeXmlRequest.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
128        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
129
130      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(fullPipeline);
131      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
132
133      long processingTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
134
135      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
136
137      System.out.println("\n✅ Processing completed!");
138      System.out.println("⏱️ Processing time: " + processingTime + " ms");
139      System.out.println("📤 Response size: " + result.length() + " characters");
140
141      // Show sample of result
142      String[] lines = result.split("\n");
143      System.out.println("\n📋 Sample response (first 10 lines):");
144      for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(10, lines.length); i++) {
145        System.out.println(lines[i]);
146      }
147      if (lines.length > 10) {
148        System.out.println("... (" + (lines.length - 10) + " more lines)");
149      }
150    }
151
152    System.out.println("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
153  }
154
155  /** Demonstrates error handling and recovery */
156  private static void demonstrateErrorHandling() throws IOException {
157    System.out.println("⚠️ Error Handling and Recovery");
158    System.out.println("===============================");
159
160    // Invalid XML for testing error handling
161    String invalidXml =
162        """
163        <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
164        <request>
165          <header>
166            <requestId>REQ002</requestId>
167            <!-- Missing closing tag for demonstration -->
168          </header>
169        """;
170
171    System.out.println("🔍 Testing error handling with invalid XML...");
172
173    try {
174      IStreamCommand xmlProcessor =
175          XmlNavigateCommand.create("request/header/requestId", new PassThroughRule());
176      processStep(invalidXml, xmlProcessor, "Error handling test");
177    } catch (Exception e) {
178      System.out.println("❌ Expected error caught: " + e.getMessage());
179      System.out.println("🔄 Implementing recovery strategy...");
180
181      // Recovery: Try to process what we can
182      String recoveredXml =
183          """
184          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
185          <error>
186            <code>INVALID_XML</code>
187            <message>Request XML is malformed</message>
188            <timestamp>2023-07-15T10:30:00Z</timestamp>
189          </error>
190          """;
191
192      processStep(
193          recoveredXml,
194          XmlNavigateCommand.create("error", new PassThroughRule()),
195          "Recovery processing");
196    }
197
198    System.out.println("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
199  }
200
201  /** Demonstrates performance optimization techniques */
202  private static void demonstratePerformanceOptimization() throws IOException {
203    System.out.println("⚡ Performance Optimization");
204    System.out.println("============================");
205
206    // Generate multiple requests for concurrent processing
207    String[] requests = generateMultipleRequests();
208
209    System.out.println("🔄 Processing " + requests.length + " requests concurrently...");
210
211    long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
212
213    // Process requests concurrently
214    CompletableFuture<String>[] futures = new CompletableFuture[requests.length];
215
216    for (int i = 0; i < requests.length; i++) {
217      final String request = requests[i];
218      final int requestId = i + 1;
219
220      futures[i] =
221          CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(
222              () -> {
223                try {
224                  return processRequestConcurrently(request, requestId);
225                } catch (Exception e) {
226                  return "Error processing request " + requestId + ": " + e.getMessage();
227                }
228              },
229              executor);
230    }
231
232    // Wait for all requests to complete
233    CompletableFuture.allOf(futures).join();
234
235    long totalTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
236
237    System.out.println("✅ All requests processed!");
238    System.out.println("⏱️ Total time: " + totalTime + " ms");
239    System.out.println("📊 Average time per request: " + (totalTime / requests.length) + " ms");
240    System.out.println(
241        "🚀 Throughput: " + (requests.length * 1000.0 / totalTime) + " requests/second");
242
243    // Show some results
244    System.out.println("\n📋 Sample results:");
245    for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(3, futures.length); i++) {
246      System.out.println(
247          "Request "
248              + (i + 1)
249              + " result: "
250              + futures[i].join().substring(0, Math.min(100, futures[i].join().length()))
251              + "...");
252    }
253
254    System.out.println("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
255  }
256
257  /** Creates a comprehensive processing pipeline */
258  private static IStreamCommand[] createFullProcessingPipeline() {
259    return new IStreamCommand[] {
260      // Step 1: Extract user ID from incoming XML
261      XmlNavigateCommand.create("request/body/user/userId", new PassThroughRule()),
262
263      // Step 2: Database lookup (simulated with sample processing)
264      new SampleStreamCommand("database-lookup-simulator"),
265
266      // Step 3: API call to backend service (simulated)
267      new SendHttpCommand("https://api.backend.example.com/user/profile"),
268
269      // Step 4: Process returned XML
270      XmlNavigateCommand.create("response/data", new PassThroughRule())
271    };
272  }
273
274  /** Generates a large XML request for testing */
275  private static String generateLargeXmlRequest() {
276    StringBuilder xml = new StringBuilder();
277    xml.append("<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n");
278    xml.append("<request>\n");
279    xml.append("  <header>\n");
280    xml.append("    <requestId>REQ_LARGE_001</requestId>\n");
281    xml.append("    <timestamp>2023-07-15T10:30:00Z</timestamp>\n");
282    xml.append("    <source>enterprise-system</source>\n");
283    xml.append("  </header>\n");
284    xml.append("  <body>\n");
285    xml.append("    <user>\n");
286    xml.append("      <userId>USR_LARGE_123</userId>\n");
287    xml.append("      <sessionId>SES_LARGE_456</sessionId>\n");
288    xml.append("      <action>bulkUserOperation</action>\n");
289    xml.append("    </user>\n");
290    xml.append("    <data>\n");
291
292    // Add many data elements to simulate large XML
293    for (int i = 1; i <= 1000; i++) {
294      xml.append("      <record>\n");
295      xml.append("        <id>").append(i).append("</id>\n");
296      xml.append("        <name>Record_").append(i).append("</name>\n");
297      xml.append("        <value>").append(Math.random() * 1000).append("</value>\n");
298      xml.append("        <status>active</status>\n");
299      xml.append("      </record>\n");
300    }
301
302    xml.append("    </data>\n");
303    xml.append("  </body>\n");
304    xml.append("</request>");
305
306    return xml.toString();
307  }
308
309  /** Generates multiple requests for concurrent processing */
310  private static String[] generateMultipleRequests() {
311    String[] requests = new String[50];
312
313    for (int i = 0; i < requests.length; i++) {
314      requests[i] =
315          String.format(
316              """
317          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
318          <request>
319            <header>
320              <requestId>REQ_%03d</requestId>
321              <timestamp>2023-07-15T10:30:00Z</timestamp>
322              <source>load-test</source>
323            </header>
324            <body>
325              <user>
326                <userId>USR_%03d</userId>
327                <sessionId>SES_%03d</sessionId>
328                <action>getProfile</action>
329              </user>
330              <parameters>
331                <param name="format">xml</param>
332              </parameters>
333            </body>
334          </request>
335          """,
336              i + 1, i + 1, i + 1);
337    }
338
339    return requests;
340  }
341
342  /** Processes a single request concurrently */
343  private static String processRequestConcurrently(String request, int requestId)
344      throws IOException {
345    try (InputStream inputStream =
346            new ByteArrayInputStream(request.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
347        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
348
349      // Simulate processing pipeline
350      IStreamCommand[] pipeline = {
351        XmlNavigateCommand.create("request/body/user/userId", new PassThroughRule())
352      };
353
354      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(pipeline);
355      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
356
357      return "Request "
358          + requestId
359          + " processed: "
360          + outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
361    }
362  }
363
364  /** Helper method to process a single step and show results */
365  private static void processStep(String inputXml, IStreamCommand command, String stepName)
366      throws IOException {
367    try (InputStream inputStream =
368            new ByteArrayInputStream(inputXml.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
369        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
370
371      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(new IStreamCommand[] {command});
372      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
373
374      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
375      System.out.println("✅ " + stepName + " result:");
376      System.out.println(result.trim());
377    }
378  }
379}
